results.title: Adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX Fails to Improve Disease-Free Survival Over mFOLFOX6 in High-Risk Stage III Colon Cancer
results.description: Jaafar Bennouna, MD, PhD, discusses results from the phase 3 IROCAS trial comparing adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX with mFOLFOX6 in patients with resected high-risk stage III colon cancer, highlighting the absence of disease-free survival improvement, increased gastrointestinal toxicity, and the need for novel adjuvant strategies beyond pathologic risk-based chemotherapy intensification.

results.title: UN body agrees to postpone review of US rights record after Trump administration snub
results.description: GENEVA: The UN’s top human rights body on Tuesday postponed a regular review of the US human rights record until January in hopes of persuading the Trump administration to reverse its decision to become the first government to snub the process. The move by the Human Rights Council buys it more time to try to coax Washington to take part in the review. The council’s 47 member countries adopted without a vote the decision to delay the US review — amid “continued non-cooperation” with its process.
